thread:
Maya Bennett: Quick sync: we need a single error subcode scheme so routing, quotas, and the console agree. Goals: stable SDK behavior and actionable console badges.
Kevin Liu: Keep HTTP codes unchanged. Use a short header X-RW-Subcode and a tiny JSON body with subcode + retryable flag.
Sasha Ortiz: Console wants fixed buckets, not freeform strings. Propose mapping subcodes -> {Retryable, ActionRequired, Degraded}.
Ravi Patel: Customers see 429 for many things. We should separate rate.limit (retryable), quota.exhausted (action required), policy.block (action required), degrade.unavailable (degraded).
Ana Gomez: Console UX: one visible badge per route with color mapping (Retryable=orange, ActionRequired=red, Degraded=yellow). Tooltip shows subcodes + runbook link.
Kevin Liu: Infra action: publish error_catalog.v1.json with entries like rate.limit, quota.exhausted, policy.block, route.mismatch, degrade.unavailable. Keep keys compact.
Sasha Ortiz: SDKs: auto-retry on retryable subcodes with exponential backoff (default 3 attempts). Non-retryable -> surface typed error with runbook URL in metadata.
Ravi Patel: Telemetry: emit routing.decision events with subcode, decision, target_model, rollout_id, tenant_id. Also emit metrics requests.by_subcode and latency.by_subcode. Alerts on spikes of quota.exhausted.
Maya Bennett: For graceful degrade when we intentionally serve cheaper model, return 200 with degraded=true and degraded_model id. Only use 503 for hard unavailable.
Ana Gomez: Rollout UX: overlay active rollout config on the subcode charts so PMs and SREs can see effect.
Maya Bennett: Owners: Sasha -> spec + error_catalog, Ravi -> telemetry + dashboards, Kevin -> SDK updates, Ana -> console badges + copy. ops-bot: RFC link created (auto).
Maya Bennett: Thanks all, will review Sasha's draft tomorrow.
